steps.title: Investigate and repair
steps.goal: A customer saw two collection records before leaving the building. A counter lookup should work even when the log is unavailable. Collection adds one counter name and preserves earlier records. Oversized parcels use freight and other parcels use their zone. Keep both public entry points. The counter policy may change when a depot is added.
